description: Melee arena combat: two fighters with health, range-based attacks, hit detection, and an AI opponent that chases and attacks.

behavioral_invariants.description: A successful attack reduces the target's health by the attacker's AttackDamage.
behavioral_invariants.precondition: Attacker and target are alive and within AttackRange.

behavioral_invariants.description: When a fighter's health reaches zero it is marked dead.
behavioral_invariants.precondition: Fighter is alive with health greater than zero.
behavioral_invariants.expected_result: fighter.IsDead becomes true and Health is clamped to 0.

behavioral_invariants.description: An attack against a target outside AttackRange does not connect and deals no damage.
behavioral_invariants.precondition: Target is farther than AttackRange from the attacker.
behavioral_invariants.expected_result: Attack returns false and target.Health is unchanged.

behavioral_invariants.description: A dead fighter cannot attack and cannot be damaged further.
behavioral_invariants.expected_result: No damage is applied and Attack returns false.
